profile.headline: Software Engineer, VR at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on apps for high-profile clients like Scotts Lawn Care and SoulCycle
- Led a team of engineers through a 1.0 product-release cycle
- Engaged the team on the transition from Objective-C to Swift
- Designed and contributed to a company-wide, open-source style guide for Swift
- Presented at high-profile meetups, such as iOSoho
- Assisted with additions to company-wide development standards
- Developed and maintained internal tools and frameworks for faster development on internal and external projects.

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on apps for high-profile clients like Alex and Ani and SoulCycle
- Led a team of engineers through several product release cycles
- Contributed to company-wide open source initiatives
- Wrote blog posts related to relevant industry items

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Managed a team of three in developing and delivering programs based on client requirements
- Wrote detailed specifications for the development team to build custom applications
- Developed an application in MVC for automatic updating and editing kiosk designs
- Developed an iPad application utilizing Objective-C for running kiosks in a mobile environment
- Worked alongside clients in developing custom web applications to manage customer flow
- Configuration of client installations, including SQL Server 2008, IIS 7.0, 
- Utilized HTML, CSS, Javascript (+ jQuery) to develop web applications
